def main():
    import sys

    data = input().split()
    
    index = 0
    N = int(data[index])
    M = int(data[index + 1])
    Q = int(data[index + 2])
    index += 3
    
    graph = defaultdict(list)
    for _ in range(M):
        u = int(data[index])
        v = int(data[index + 1])

        graph[v].append(u)
        index += 2

    for _ in range(Q):
        a = int(data[index])
        b = int(data[index + 1])
        queries.append((a, b))
        index += 2

        queue = deque([(start, 0)])
        visited = [False] * (N + 1)
        visited[start] = True
